svg.aria-label: Six checks before the first shot, from the Tikka manual: 1 push a dry patch through the bore from the breech end; 2 wipe extra oil from the bolt and chamber; 3 lightly grease the locking lugs, cocking cam and cocking piece head; 4 sights clean; 5 receiver screws tight; 6 insert the bolt and mount the scope by the ring maker's instructions. Do it unloaded, over a table.

g.data-tip: Check 1|Dry patch through the bore, from the breech. From the Tikka manual, assembly of packaged firearm.
g.text: Dry patch through the bore, from the breech

g.data-tip: Check 2|Wipe extra oil from bolt and chamber. From the Tikka manual, assembly of packaged firearm.
g.text: Wipe extra oil from bolt and chamber

g.data-tip: Check 3|Grease: lugs, cam, cocking piece. From the Tikka manual, assembly of packaged firearm.
Check 4|Sights clean and clear. From the Tikka manual, assembly of packaged firearm.
Check 5|Receiver screws tight. From the Tikka manual, assembly of packaged firearm.
Check 6|Bolt in. Scope per the ring maker. From the Tikka manual, assembly of packaged firearm.
g.text: Bolt in. Scope per the ring maker

svg.text: Unloaded and proved first. Over a table.
